ValidationRule.description:
If not SF Admin, cannot edit "SOW #"
JIRA Ticket: AEOM-91
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(SOW__c))), ISCHANGED( SOW__c ), $User.Profile_Name__c != 'System Administrator', NOT( $Permission.BypassValidationRules ), NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Propose")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Salesforce Administrator" access required to edit this field
